how_to_apply: Visit the NABARD website at www.nabard.org and under Career Notices, click on "APPLY HERE" below the concerned recruitment advertisement.
Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details, and Email-id to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password.
Fill out the online application carefully, using "SAVE AND NEXT" to verify details before submission.
Upload scanned photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and handwritten declaration according to the prescribed specifications.
Upload the latest C.V./Resume and Proof of current Cost to Company in .pdf format (max size 500 KB).
Proceed to the 'Payment' tab and complete the online fee payment using available digital payment modes.
Click on 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' after ensuring all uploaded details and files are correct.
Take a printout of the e-Receipt and system-generated online application form for future reference.
important_instructions: Candidates serving in Govt./Quasi Govt. offices, Public Sector undertakings, and Nationalized Banks must submit a 'No Objection Certificate' from their employer at the time of interview. The engagement is on contract for a period of 02 years, extendable for a further period of 03 years (one year at a time, not beyond 05 years). The Specialists shall not be entitled to any superannuation benefits like Provident Fund, Pension, or Gratuity. Quarters may be allotted based on request and availability against payment of a licence fee of 0.5% of remuneration, or a fixed HRA of 10% of remuneration in case of non-allotment. The Bank reserves the right to increase, decrease, modify, or cancel the recruitment process without assigning any reason. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. No travel expenses will be paid if mandatory NOC is not produced during the interview by employed candidates. The contract can be terminated by either party by giving one month's notice in advance.

content_sections.heading: NABARD Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: NABARD has announced a total of 16 vacancies for Specialists on contract under the Chief Information Security Office (CISO) and Department of Supervision (DoS) - CSITE departments.

content_sections.heading: NABARD Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility criteria including educational qualifications, experience, and age limits are determined as on 01.10.2026.

rows.qualification_required: BE / B.Tech in Computer Science/ Computer Engineering/ Information Technology/ Electronics & Communication/ Information Science/ Electrical/ Cyber Security; OR MCA; OR Post Graduate degree in Computer Science / Information Technology/ Cyber Security/ Information Security/ Computer Engineering/ Information Systems/ Software Engineering/ Electronics & Communication Engineering (minimum of 60% marks or equivalent grade) along with mandatory certification (CompTIA Security+ / CEH / Equivalent cyber security certification).

BE / B.Tech in Computer Science/ Computer Engineering/ Information Technology/ Electronics & Communication/ Information Science/ Electrical/ Cyber Security; OR MCA; OR Post Graduate degree in Computer Science / Information Technology/ Cyber Security/ Information Security/ Computer Engineering/ Information Systems/ Software Engineering/ Electronics & Communication Engineering (minimum of 60% marks or equivalent grade) along with mandatory certification (CISA / CISM / CISSP / Equivalent certification in Information Security / IT Risk / Compliance).

BE / B.Tech in Computer Science/ Computer Engineering/ Information Technology/ Electronics & Communication/ Information Science/ Electrical/ Cyber Security; OR MCA; OR Post Graduate degree in Computer Science / Information Technology/ Cyber Security/ Information Security/ Computer Engineering/ Information Systems/ Software Engineering/ Electronics & Communication Engineering (minimum of 60% marks or equivalent grade) along with mandatory certification (CCNP Security / Equivalent certification in network / infrastructure security).

BE / B.Tech in Computer Science/ Computer Engineering/ Information Technology/ Electronics & Communication/ Information Science/ Electrical/ Cyber Security; OR MCA; OR Post Graduate degree in Computer Science / Information Technology/ Cyber Security/ Information Security/ Computer Engineering/ Information Systems/ Software Engineering/ Electronics & Communication Engineering (minimum of 60% marks or equivalent grade) along with mandatory certification (CEH / OSCP / ECSA / Equivalent certification in penetration testing / offensive security).

B.E./B. Tech in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), or Information Technology (IT); OR Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline with a Master’s degree in Computer Science/IT / ECE, along with mandatory certifications: CISA plus at least one of CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, or Lead Implementer and CISA.

B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), or Information Technology (IT); OR Bachelor’s degree in any discipline with a Master’s in Computer Science/IT/ECE, along with mandatory certifications: CISA plus at least one of CCNA, CCNP, CEH, or CISM.

B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), or Information Technology (IT); OR Bachelor’s degree in any discipline with a Master's in Computer Science/IT/ECE, along with mandatory certifications: CISA plus at least one of CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, or PCI DSS implementation certification (PCIP/ ISA/QSA/CPISI).

B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), or Information Technology (IT); OR Bachelor’s degree in any discipline with a Master's in Computer Science/IT/ECE, along with at least one certification from CEH, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, Database Certification (Oracle/ Microsoft SQL), or Cloud Certification (AWS / GCP / Microsoft Azure/ Oracle).
